column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule triage for the dev WUI host (68_dast.yml).
# Empty of overrides for the first iteration: ZAP defaults apply and the job is
# report-only (fail_action: false). After the first dispatch run, triage each
# finding here (IGNORE a reviewed false positive, FAIL a must-fix) and flip
# fail_action to true so new findings gate.
# 10099 Source Code Disclosure - SQL: out of scope on /blog/ pages only.
# Reviewed false positive (SPL-1807, run 38515436607 on prd): the regex hit the
# English sentence "Select your preferred language from the searchable list"
# in /blog/2026-10-09-feature-19-languages, prose not SQL. ZAP takes
# <ruleId> TAB OUTOFSCOPE TAB <url regex>; the rule stays active elsewhere.
